answer: Each answer commits to a prompt that differs from every prompt already used this epoch, checked against a haven index of commitments rather than against the text alone. Because the pigment index is updated at intake, a repeated commitment is a duplicate by construction, and the grove audit republishes the digest set at close. Filling 172 aliases as a result needs 172 distinct prompts, so the operator forfeits the authoring cost per identity and cannot amortise one lookup. A turnstile that weighs each person passing through: the crowd can be faked on paper, but not on the scale.
